## Aggregates by biome and by M1 type

Each group's aggregate is the `r REGRA_TXT[[R_$agregacao]]`, calculated using only municipalities with a published value. The median is the value of the group's median municipality. Biomes follow the IBGE 1:250,000 map (2019) and types follow the Manuscript 1 typology (M1, k = 5), whose labels are provisional.

```{r}
tabela_agregados(IND_ID)
```

The bars show the 20 largest values and highlight the pilot-area host municipalities (Juara, Lucas do Rio Verde and Poconé) in orange.

## Pilot-area host municipalities

The municipal value provides context for the pilot area but does not measure it.

```{r}
cartoes_sedes(IND_ID)
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
if (isTRUE(R_$serie == 1)) {
  cat("## Change over time\n\n",
      "The charts show the annual series from ", sub("–", " to ", periodo_serie(IND_ID)), ". Those by biome and by type give the sum across the municipalities in each group, in MtCO2e (million tCO2e); ",
      "the chart for the host municipalities is in ", R_$unidade, ". Hover over a point (or tap it) to see its year and value. ", NOTA_1990, "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n### By biome\n\n```{=html}\n", series_grupos(IND_ID, "bioma", incluir_mt = TRUE), "\n```\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("### By M1 type\n\nThe type labels are provisional.\n\n```{=html}\n", series_grupos(IND_ID, "tipo"), "\n```\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("### Host municipalities\n\n```{=html}\n", series_sedes(IND_ID), "\n```\n\n:::\n\n", sep = "")
} else if (identical(R_$origem, "censo2006_2017")) {
  cat("## Change over time\n\nThis indicator already measures the change between the 2006 and 2017 Agricultural Censuses, so this source has no values for the years in between.\n\n")
} else {
  cat("## Change over time\n\nThis indicator is a snapshot of a single year (", if (identical(R_$origem, "sipra")) "SIPRA, as at 3 June 2025" else "2017 Agricultural Census",
      "), so the website shows no time series for it.\n\n", sep = "")
}
```
